people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Tahpanhes
people.line: Egyptian city where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem's destruction

translations.web: and they came into the land of Egypt; for they didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice: and they came to Tahpanhes.
translations.bsb: So they entered the land of Egypt because they did not obey the voice of the LORD, and they went as far as Tahpanhes.
translations.kjv: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
translations.asv: and they came into the land of Egypt; for they obeyed not the voice of Jehovah: and they came unto Tahpanhes.
